root_cause: PR #138 replaced five nested conditional expressions independently with identical four-line quote-state branches, which made 20 new duplicated lines visible to SonarQube Cloud. Its behavior-preserving branch rewrite also raised command_summary cognitive complexity from the allowed 15 to 16. PR #144's second corrective head eliminated its new duplicated lines but its expanded checker introduced one immutable include literal three times. In PR #151, parse_cli kept four value-option paths inline and measured cognitive complexity 29 where 25 is allowed; the normal local extraction into parse_cli_value_option preserves the parser's option-value contract. PR #153's retained final receipt proves that S1066 receipt AZ9cRy9OHhV2CayPTP4Z is remediated at its exact head but does not establish a prior source location, so no unrecorded path is claimed. Initial PR #156 added seven source-wiring unittest assertions with expected values before actual values, which SonarQube Cloud reported as python:S3415; its successor exact-head receipt has no direct PR issues. The Envoy receipt AZ9cRyqvHhV2CayPTP0H was a Go interface-name convention violation: internal processor.Engine had one Open method but used an implementation-style name. The older #74 causes remain historical evidence for the same aggregate Quality-Gate lifecycle.
proposed_remediation: For #138, use a local behavior-preserving non-nested quote-state expression that does not duplicate a multi-line branch across the five generators, and extract the new full-runtime-status decision into a small pure helper so command_summary remains below the cognitive-complexity threshold. The #144 checker-local constant remediation, the #151 parse_cli value-option helper extraction, and the #153 S1066 corrective portion are complete and clean at their exact Draft heads. PR #156 final exact head 59ff4d5bbb6e278d93c0b965096e842b77f446bb now has a bounded zero-issue Draft-PR receipt after the seven assertion-order corrections; PR #214 replaces Envoy processor.Engine with the behavior-preserving one-method interface name TransactionOpener. If either exact head changes, retain a new exact-head Sonar/GitHub receipt before relying on the result. For every future successor, run focused controls, documentation and diff checks, then re-read the exact-head SonarQube Cloud Quality Gate, issues, measures, and applicable GitHub checks. Do not change SonarQube Cloud policy or use a suppression.
